content.summary: Heart failure (HF) can occur in patients with cancer due to cardiotoxic effects of anticancer therapies. Table 23 lists cancer therapies known to cause heart failure and their indications.

table23_cancer_drugs_causing_heart_failu.Indication: Breast cancer, lymphoma, acute leukaemia, sarcoma

table23_cancer_drugs_causing_heart_failu.Examples: trastuzumab, pertuzumab, trastuzumab emtansine (T-DM1), lapatinib, neratinib, tucatinib
table23_cancer_drugs_causing_heart_failu.Indication: HER2+ breast cancer; HER2+ gastric cancer

table23_cancer_drugs_causing_heart_failu.Examples: TKIs: sunitinib, pazopanib, sorafenib, axitinib, tivantinib(?), cabozantinib, regorafenib, lenvatinib, vandetanib; Antibodies: bevacizumab, ramucirumab
table23_cancer_drugs_causing_heart_failu.Indication: VEGF TKIs: renal cancer, hepatocellular cancer, thyroid cancer, colon cancer, sarcoma, GIST; Antibodies: breast cancer, ovarian cancer, gastric cancer, gastro-oesophageal cancer, colon cancer

table23_cancer_drugs_causing_heart_failu.Examples: second and third generation BCR-ABL TKIs: ponatinib, nilotinib, dasatinib, bosutinib

genes.context: Listed under 'HER2-targeted therapies' with examples (trastuzumab, pertuzumab, T-DM1, lapatinib, neratinib, tucatinib) and indicated for HER2+ breast and gastric cancer.
Referenced as 'BCR-ABL TKIs' (ponatinib, nilotinib, dasatinib, bosutinib) in the multi-targeted kinase inhibitors row, indicated for chronic myeloid leukaemia.

Presented as 'VEGF inhibitors' (TKIs and antibodies including bevacizumab, ramucirumab); indications list VEGF TKI and antibody-associated cancers such as renal, hepatocellular, thyroid, colon, sarcoma, GIST and several epithelial cancers.
